tasks.title: Let a user recover from a failed save
tasks.prompt: Complete the form interaction. Submitting invokes window.runTask. Show a useful error and a visible, named Retry button on failure. Retry must run the task again and announce its successful Saved result. Preserve the form's accessible input label and avoid duplicate submission handlers.

files.app.js: document.querySelector('#form').addEventListener('submit', async event => { event.preventDefault(); try { document.querySelector('#status').textContent = await window.runTask(); } catch { document.querySelector('#status').textContent = 'The save failed.'; } });

tasks.title: Require both authority and current approval
tasks.prompt: Correct allowed(roles, approved). Only an admin with approved is True may proceed. Members, missing roles, missing approval, and truthy non-boolean approval values must fail closed.

files.access.py:
def allowed(roles, approved):
    return 'admin' in roles or bool(approved)
